status_at_registration: No A0 or B/C/D GPU execution; runtime uploaded, CPU tests passed.

design.A: P0/T0 native output reused only after actual A0 equality gate
design.note: Native formatting rounds pair timestamps; content shift and displayed label difference are not the same numeric quantity.

fixed: dense VAE condition, actual noise, token counts/tags/packed positions, prompt, native attention
primary and sensitivity pose windows, confidence thresholds and reject gates

exploratory_meaningful_effect.same_effect_across_other_factor: Both contrasts for a factor must have same sign and pass magnitude gate; no sign is presumed from metadata alone.
exploratory_meaningful_effect.shape_coverage: Keep existing frozen observer reject rules; report residuals and same-frame errors. Do not treat rejected lag as zero.
exploratory_meaningful_effect.quality: No gross identity reversion, background destruction or action-shape failure for full success. Pose-only result must be labeled as such.

limits: One source/seed factorial diagnostic, not statistical inference.
Four arms do not establish universal dual-clock conflict or architectural novelty.
Effect on Qwen hidden states includes lexical/contextual effects; text timestamp edit is not a direct RoPE intervention.
No additional FPS/phase sweep automatically appended if this fixed probe is negative.
A0 is encoding/noise acceptance only, not an independent quality inference.
Normal-case and second-seed replication would be required before advocating correction.
